environmentConcept.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PREVIEW-ONLY environment concept approval board for the 2D side-scrolling painted Japanese fantasy game Kiba Realms. Image 1 is style reference for the existing safe forest refuge: detailed painterly cedar and bamboo woods at blue hour, orange lanterns, indigo cloth and natural earthy textures. Image 2 is character/style reference for a muscular black shiba smith, glasses tan female shiba herbalist, elderly cream shiba enchanter and cruel human samurai camp captain. Create a NEW LANDSCAPE concept sheet with exactly FOUR large separate rectangular environment vignettes in a clean 2 by 2 layout, fine parchment gutters, numerals 1,2,3,4 only. Each vignette has a readable completely horizontal walkable earth/wood floor near the bottom and a side-scrolling game-view camera; no isometric camera or bird's-eye view. Detailed painted fantasy scenery, fine worn wood, stone, fabric, rich natural foliage and strong readable lights. This is visual design exploration, not a production game background and not a sprite atlas. All spaces are independent locations connected later by doors, NOT adjacent rooms in one continuous building. No modern machinery, text, UI, map labels, watermarks, gore or graphic violence. PANEL 1 TOP LEFT: a large enclosed hostile HUMAN SAMURAI CAMP exterior in cedar woods at dusk, uneven timber palisades, dark red weathered Japanese banners with simple abstract cloth patterns not writing, bamboo watchtower, pitched indigo/crimson military tents and stacked crates, a clearly distinguishable execution courtyard at right with a raised bare timber platform and an upright chopping block, no blood or bodies. Three sturdy separate captive cages stand left and center of the courtyard beside a clear path; simple tiny shiba captive silhouettes may occupy them but scenery is the focus. The imposing human samurai captain stands on the far-right platform as a small readable scale reference, with no attack being performed. No medieval European castle or prison bars everywhere. A generous clear traversable foreground path connects cages and court. Composition invites entering from left, rescuing prisoners, then approaching the courtyard. Strong red/umber versus cool blue shadow palette, amber brazier lighting, ominous oppressive atmosphere. PANEL 2 TOP RIGHT: cozy SMALL JAPANESE BLACKSMITH FORGE INTERIOR built from thick dark cedar posts, rough plaster walls and stone kiln, warm orange open forge at rear left with hand-operated bellows, anvil behind walk path, rack of complete swords, leather apron/tools, water barrel, charcoal, scattered restrained hammering sparks in the hearth only. A muscular black-and-tan shiba smith in work clothes is a small scale reference behind the anvil, NOT blocking the clear foreground floor. Wooden sliding exit door on left edge, small lantern; warm welcoming professional workshop with soot-stained materials, no enemies. PANEL 3 BOTTOM LEFT: SMALL FOREST HERBALIST HUT INTERIOR, simple cedar cabin, round daylight opening looking onto blue cedar forest, warm hanging lantern, drying tied herb bundles under rafters, wicker herb baskets, green plant beds and ceramic jars at back, modest low wooden preparation table with mortar and pestle plus one small 3-HP potion-like glass bottle with jade-green liquid and cork, no printed labels; friendly tan/golden female shiba herbalist with round spectacles as a small scale reference beside worktable. Handwoven mats and timber floor, green and ochre palette, intact sliding door at left, clear uncluttered foreground path. Practical traditional medicine, not a chemistry laboratory. PANEL 4 BOTTOM RIGHT: SMALL MYSTIC ENCHANTER TENT INTERIOR, spacious inside a fabric shelter hung from timber crossbeams, layered plum and faded-indigo silk with embroidered gold abstract knot patterns not writing, warm lanterns and a restrained soft violet Kiba glow from a suspended talisman, low altar and closed books at rear, ropes/cloth bundles/small incense burner, elderly cream female shiba in purple robes holding ONE wooden staff, as a small scale reference. Clearly visible cloth flap exit left, worn wood planks or woven floor with clear horizontal walkable foreground, cozy mystical atmosphere, no cavern, no floating stairs. Preserve game readability, generous ceiling/floor space, complete architecture and scene borders. No extra panels or isolated inventory icons.
notes: Characters in these environment studies are scale references only. Production backgrounds will omit baked-in characters and interactive objects that move or change state.
All three service locations are separate small interior side areas reached from the Forest Refuge.
No production backgrounds or animations generated.
